{{Quote|Look out!|RC-1138 tries to warn a trooper before the Geonosian kills him|<ref name="SWRC" />}}
A '''Geonosian warrior''' fought in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]]<ref name="SWRC" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> at the outset of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and a separatist group known as the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. A Republic [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] was hovering above the ground to deploy a clone trooper and [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Boss (clone commando)/Legends|Boss]], so the two could rappel down. The [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Warrior caste (Geonosian)/Legends|warrior]] flew behind the [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] and the [[Commando/Legends|commando]], seeing this, tried to warn the other [[Cloning/Legends|clone]]. Before either [[Soldier/Legends|Soldiers]] could react, the Geonosian grabbed the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] and flew off, [[Death/Legends|killing]] [[Gender/Legends|him]] by dropping him to the ground.<ref name="SWRC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Geonosian warrior's only appearance was in the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|first–person shooter]] ''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]'', which was released in [[2005]].
